tagline: Jev plays a falling-blocks puzzle, its whole mind drawn on the board, live

examples.prompt: Design a hard challenge for Jev Blocks: start with 6 garbage rows, use an S and Z heavy piece mix, set gravity to 12 with a speedup of 1, and write a style line that tells Jev to dig out first. Then watch the pane and tell me at what gravity Jev starts to miss placements.
examples.caption: Find the breaking point: a fast decision model placing every piece while it really falls

examples.prompt: Draw a custom starting board in blocks.json that is one I piece away from clearing four lines, keep gravity low, and tell Jev to go for four. Report whether it takes the four-line clear.
examples.caption: A hand-drawn board to test whether Jev sees the four-line clear
